description:
The Operations Transformation Forum will unlock new synergies between human experts and AI agents, and create an agentic operations paradigm for telecom-grade security and reliability.

#OTF2026 "Advancing Agentic Operations," hosted by #Huawei and TM Forum, takes place 22–24 June in Copenhagen, Denmark. The forum brings together operators and partners to share the latest best practices and innovation scenarios.

Join OTF2026 to gain practical insights and definitive blueprints from telecom leaders. Learn more: https://bit.ly/440FAgK #DTWignite2026
title: Join OTF2026: Advancing Agentic Operations for Faster Value Creation

author: Huawei
description:
Students from Brazil have developed an assistive cycling solution designed to support deaf and hearing-impaired cyclists. TouchBike transforms traffic sounds and environmental data into tactile and visual feedback, allowing cyclists to react more quickly while staying focused on the road.
 
Powered by #Huawei technologies, including MindSpore, ModelArts, and Huawei Cloud, the system uses sensors and edge AI to detect surrounding risks. It converts this information into tactile and visual signals through smart handlebar grips and visual alerts. TouchBike was presented at the Huawei #ICTCompetition 2025–2026 Global Final in Shenzhen.
 
The ICT competition brings together university student teams from around the world for competition and exchange, supporting innovation and digital solutions. Learn more: https://bit.ly/43C8jZ5 #ICTheFuture
title: TouchBike Enables Sensory Feedback for Safer Cycling

author: Huawei
description:
Students from the American University of Ras Al Khaimah developed Líng Huà, an Arabic-first Mandarin learning platform powered by #Huawei Cloud AI.
 
Built for native Arabic speakers, Líng Huà removes the need to translate through English, enabling direct, intuitive language learning. Powered by #Huawei technologies including SIS, NLP Machine Translation, and MindSpore, the platform delivers real-time pronunciation feedback, accurate translation, and multi-dimensional speech scoring. The solution was presented at the Huawei #ICTCompetition 2025–2026 Global Final in Shenzhen.
 
The ICT competition brings together university student teams from around the world to present innovative, real-world solutions using ICT skills. Learn more: https://bit.ly/43C8jZ5 #ICTheFuture
title: Mandarin Learning Platform Líng Huà Designed for Arabic Speakers

description:
At ISCAS 2026, Xia Jing, Huawei Fellow, uncovered the future of data center chip design in his presentation entitled "Practices of Data Center Chip Design: Tau Scaling Engineering Choices and Trade-Offs".

He examined Tau (τ) Scaling Law's LogicScaling Path—from System to Chip to Circuit—and highlighted how innovation increasingly requires coordinated advances across multiple levels of architecture and design as well as the evolution of the Kunpeng 960 roadmap.

Learn more about the Tau (τ) Scaling Law: https://bit.ly/3QeRdNX 

#HUAWEI #Innovation #Chipset #DataCenter #Semiconductors
title: Practices in Data Center Chip Design

author: Huawei
description:
At ISCAS 2026, Huang Yong, Huawei Fellow, gave a presentation entitled "LogicFolding in Mobile SoC Design", sharing insights into how to continue advancing performance and efficiency as traditional scaling becomes increasingly complex.

He explored LogicFolding as a successful implementation of Tau (τ) Scaling for mobile SoCs, discussing practical engineering considerations as well as the design flow and methodology challenges that must be addressed to bring these innovations into production.

Learn more about the Tau (τ) Scaling Law: https://bit.ly/3QeRdNX
